standards.title: One Fact, One Authority
standards.requirement: Every mutable business fact MUST have one authoritative writer. Caches, projections, UI state and AI memory MUST NOT silently become alternative sources of truth.
standards.rationale: EcoFlow repeatedly accumulated conflicting commercial, operational, browser and historical interpretations until ownership was made explicit.

standards.title: Command over Snapshot
standards.requirement: A consequential mutation SHOULD submit a bounded business intent/command rather than replace a client-held aggregate snapshot.
standards.rationale: Whole-state writes hide intent, make auditing weak and magnify stale-device overwrites.

standards.title: Revisioned Mutation
standards.requirement: Cross-device mutable aggregates with consequential effects MUST use a server-owned revision or equivalent compare-and-swap token. Revision mismatch MUST surface as an explicit conflict rather than silent last-write-wins.
standards.rationale: Client serialization alone cannot prevent second-device stale overwrites.

standards.title: Replay-safe Commands
standards.requirement: Retryable consequential commands MUST carry a stable idempotency/command key. Replaying the same normalized intent MUST not duplicate side effects; reusing the key for a different intent MUST fail.
standards.rationale: Network ambiguity and repeated UI actions are normal production conditions.

standards.title: Cursor Is Not Revision
standards.requirement: Transport cursors/change sequences MUST be treated only as read-progress ordering mechanisms. They MUST NOT be substituted for business revision, idempotency or conflict control.
standards.rationale: Lossless incremental reads and safe concurrent writes solve different failure classes.

standards.title: Unknown Is Not Zero
standards.requirement: Systems MUST preserve the distinction between confirmed zero, null/missing, unknown, invalid, unavailable, stale and not-established values whenever that distinction affects a decision.
standards.rationale: Fabricated or inferred zeros caused misleading dashboards, inventory and analytics states.

standards.title: Value Requires Provenance
standards.requirement: Decision-relevant values SHOULD carry or be resolvable to source, authority, freshness and quality/capability metadata.
standards.rationale: A number without origin or freshness cannot safely drive operational or AI action.

standards.title: Separate Data Planes
standards.requirement: Raw ingestion, operational authority, read/projection models, analytics semantics and presentation SHOULD be distinct planes with explicit contracts and failure boundaries.
standards.rationale: Success in ingestion, projection or UI repeatedly failed to prove correctness in the next layer.

standards.title: Bounded Convergence
standards.requirement: Long-running import, reconciliation or projection work MUST be bounded by page/batch/time budgets, persist progress, resume safely and require explicit convergence evidence. Mature systems MUST also review write amplification and steady-state cadence.
standards.rationale: Monolithic work repeatedly timed out; later bounded designs still incurred avoidable steady-state IO.

standards.title: Failure Must Become State
standards.requirement: Relevant failures MUST become explicit typed states or failed workflow outcomes. Silent swallowing and false-green execution are prohibited for states that affect operational correctness.
standards.rationale: Hidden structured errors and non-blocking failed read-model refreshes made healthy-looking systems operationally degraded.

standards.title: Local Cache Is Recovery, Not Truth
standards.requirement: Browser/device storage MAY hold cache, pending journal or recovery state, but MUST NOT be the final authority for consequential shared business state. Clearing local storage MUST NOT change authoritative business facts.
standards.rationale: Device-local truth produces divergent realities across staff devices.

standards.title: Server Enforces Authority
standards.requirement: UI visibility is not authorization. Consequential permissions, state transitions and business invariants MUST be revalidated by a trusted server/transaction boundary.
standards.rationale: A deployed RPC replacement weakened warehouse guards until server enforcement was restored.

standards.title: Capability over Role Guessing
standards.requirement: Clients SHOULD consume server-issued action capabilities when permissions depend on state, data readiness or role. They MUST NOT infer authority from visible text, route labels or decorative role strings.
standards.rationale: Text-based role detection caused blank workspaces; later analytics and lifecycle flows used explicit capability envelopes.

standards.title: Forward-only Migration
standards.requirement: A migration that may have been applied MUST NOT be edited. Corrections MUST use forward compensation. Pending migrations may only be amended when production history proves they are unapplied.
standards.rationale: EcoFlow needed many compatibility repairs while preserving deployed history and auditability.

standards.title: Environment Is Multi-dimensional
standards.requirement: Environment parity MUST cover schema shape, public types, privileges, managed-service restrictions, historical object topology, formatting assumptions and dependency order—not merely database engine/version.
standards.rationale: Production failures arose from fields, types, view ordering, privilege policy, function body formatting and wrapper topology that fixtures did not model.

standards.title: Release Is Multi-plane
standards.requirement: Code merge, frontend deployment, database migration, server function deployment, projection/data refresh and production smoke MUST have separate evidence. One plane's success MUST NOT be used to infer another plane's completion.
standards.rationale: Wrong targets, undeployed functions, workflow ordering and stale read models all produced false assumptions of release completion.

standards.title: Stable Identity, Mutable Presentation
standards.requirement: Stable business/location/entity identifiers MUST be separated from mutable labels, layout, typography and presentation metadata.
standards.rationale: EcoFlow learned to preserve rack/location/SKU identities while allowing display and layout changes.

standards.title: Evidence Before Mutation
standards.requirement: Scans, photos, counts, mappings, GPS observations and similar field inputs SHOULD first be captured as evidence. Promotion into authoritative identity, inventory, completion or financial state MUST occur through an explicit governed transaction.
standards.rationale: Mixing capture with mutation caused barcode, stock and fulfilment ambiguity; later flows separated capture, review, publication and posting.

standards.title: Native Contracts over DOM Contracts
standards.requirement: Business navigation, permission and state ownership MUST use typed application contracts/routes/components/repositories. Visible text, DOM structure, MutationObserver or CSS hide-and-replace MUST NOT act as business interfaces.
standards.rationale: Enhancers flashed stale content, role detection broke on branding changes and recursive observers caused runtime regressions.

standards.title: Completion Has Multiple Axes
standards.requirement: Projects MUST distinguish at least Engineering Ready, Data Ready, Deployment Ready, Production Ready and Field Ready. A single DONE state MUST NOT collapse these axes.
standards.rationale: EcoFlow repeatedly had green code while data, deployment, mobile behavior or onsite acceptance remained incomplete.
